questions.question: Is app/src/components/NotificationBell.tsx's deletion a genuine, complete removal — no re-export shim left behind, no dangling `import NotificationBell` anywhere in the repo (grep for the identifier), and no orphaned dead code referencing its former exports?

Did S2 (buildInviteExpiryRows relocation), S3 (sweep rehoming), S5 (nav pills), S6 (group card pills), and S7 (contact card pills) all land before this deletion, per this story's declared dependency set — i.e. is there no window where the bell is deleted but the sweep or the replacement pill surface is still missing (TRAP 1 / TRAP 2)?

Could `Layout nav` be deleted and rewritten without modifying any file outside its `dependencies_allowed` list? If not, which cross-module dependencies exist and do they flow through declared seam contracts in architecture.md? Note: Layout nav is shared with S5 by deliberate exception to the one-owning-module-per-story rule — confirm this story's diff touches only the bell-mount-removal and i18n-key-deletion portions, not S5's pill-addition portions.

Does a repo-wide search confirm zero remaining references to `data-testid="notification-bell"`, `notification-dropdown`, or `notification-item-*` in any source or test file (not counting S9's not-yet-updated e2e specs, which are this story's explicit scope exclusion), and does app/tests/e2e/notification-bell.spec.ts no longer exist on disk?

Was this deletion sequenced strictly after the replacement surface was complete (per spec.md's TRAP1/TRAP2-driven story order), rather than deleted first and the replacement backfilled — i.e. does the git history / story_order show S2, S3, S5, S6, S7 landing before S8's commit?

After deleting the six bell-only i18n keys, does the shared `unreadMessages` key still exist in both `en` and `de`, and does UnreadCountBadge.tsx's aria-label still resolve through it without error (no runtime i18n lookup failure)?

For AC-REMOVE-1 (NotificationBell.tsx MUST NOT exist in the repository): confirm via file-existence check that the file is absent, and that no re-creation under a different filename retains the same component.

For AC-REMOVE-2 (no element with the three bell testids MUST render anywhere, desktop or mobile): show that both Layout.tsx mounts (formerly ~275 desktop, ~299 mobile) are removed, and that a grep for the three testid strings across app/src and app/pages returns no production-code hits.

For AC-REMOVE-3 (the six bell-only i18n keys MUST NOT exist in either en or de; unreadMessages MUST still exist and still back UnreadCountBadge's aria-label): show the i18n.ts diff removing all six keys from both language objects, and confirm unreadMessages remains present and referenced by UnreadCountBadge.tsx.

For AC-ETE-1 (app/tests/e2e/notification-bell.spec.ts MUST NOT exist after this epic): confirm via file-existence check that the spec file is deleted, and that no other e2e spec file was renamed to preserve its bell-only assertions under a different name — which would violate the intent, not just the letter, of this AC.
